summary: Address code smell: Shotgun Surgery: filtered locals in koruide command picker

delivery.outcome: Clear the code2llm Shotgun Surgery smell for the variable 'filtered' in packages/koruide/src/koruide/command_picker.py (planfile ticket PLF-039, reported at line 182) by replacing the generic local with a stage-accurate name in four of the five functions that mutate it and inlining the fifth into its return: non_rejected (_sanitize_antigravity_focus_open, the plugin-reported commands left after removing the rejected antigravity agent/chat openers, consumed by the preferred-side-panel ordering), allowed (_sanitize_vscodium_focus_open, the commands passing the vscodium focus_open candidate policy, passed to _prefer_commands), submit_candidates (_sanitize_cursor_submit, the commands passing the cursor submit candidate policy, with the hardcoded pair kept as the empty fallback), paste_candidates (_sanitize_cursor_paste, the commands passing the cursor paste candidate policy, with the hardcoded typeText ladder kept as the empty fallback), and _sanitize_cursor_focus_open keeps no local at all - its single-use binding is inlined into the return (pure selection), removing that mutation record outright. The code2llm shotgun-surgery detector groups mutations by (file, variable) and fires at >= 5 scopes; the 'filtered' group drops from 5 scopes to 0 and the file mutation record count drops from 78 to 77, the single removed record being the inlined cursor focus_open selection. Each new name lands at exactly 1 scope. No behavior change: same predicates, same fallbacks, same ordering; the commands parameters and the sanitize dispatch (_sanitize_focus_open_candidates, _sanitize_cursor_candidates, _sanitize_candidates) are untouched (read-only parameters and dispatch are not counted as mutations). No other file touched. No duplication.toon.yaml exists in this repository, so the duplication-report checklist has nothing to consult for the touched path.
nonGoals: No behavior, policy, filtering or interface change
No rename of other same-file mutation groups (ordered 3, rate 3, candidates 2 etc. each already below the >= 5 threshold); this lane only clears the reported 'filtered' group of the cited dedupe key

No new shared filtering helper; the five bindings sit at distinct IDE-policy stages (antigravity rejection, vscodium env-gated allowlist, cursor submit allowlist with fallback, cursor paste rejection with fallback, cursor focus_open rejection) and a forced abstraction would couple independent IDE policies
No rename of the commands parameters or the sanitize dispatch functions (read-only parameters and call routing, not counted as mutations by the detector)

architecture.decision: Stage-accurate local naming plus one pure selection, inside one module. Every function that mutated the generic name 'filtered' now names exactly the IDE-policy stage it computes: the antigravity sanitizer names the commands surviving rejection (non_rejected), the vscodium sanitizer names the env-gated policy's allowed commands (allowed), the cursor submit/paste sanitizers name their capability's surviving candidates (submit_candidates/paste_candidates, each with its pre-existing hardcoded fallback), and the cursor focus_open sanitizer returns its selection directly (the single-use local disappears). The generic name 'filtered' disappears from the file's mutation set entirely. Verified with the installed code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file's AST (standalone extract, since ProjectAnalyzer.analyze on copies/worktrees silently yields empty scopes): baseline reports a 'filtered' mutation group of exactly 5 scopes - _sanitize_antigravity_focus_open, _sanitize_vscodium_focus_open, _sanitize_cursor_submit, _sanitize_cursor_paste, _sanitize_cursor_focus_open - matching the ticket's 'spans 5 functions'; after the rename the 'filtered' group is empty, the file mutation record count drops from 78 to 77 (the removed record is the inlined cursor focus_open selection), each renamed local lands at exactly 1 scope, and no other group newly reaches the threshold (next highest: ordered/rate at 3, pre-existing).
architecture.rollback: Revert the ticket commit; the locals are named filtered again and the smell report returns.

commands: python3 -c "<standalone code2llm DFGExtractor mutation grouping on the file AST, original vs renamed content of packages/koruide/src/koruide/command_picker.py>"
validation.evidence: Deterministic ground truth with the installed code2llm extractor on the file AST. Baseline content reports a 'filtered' mutation group of 5 scopes (_sanitize_antigravity_focus_open, _sanitize_vscodium_focus_open, _sanitize_cursor_submit, _sanitize_cursor_paste, _sanitize_cursor_focus_open) - exactly matching the ticket's reported 'spans 5 functions'; renamed content reports a 'filtered' group of 0 scopes; file mutation record count drops from 78 to 77 (the removed record is the inlined _sanitize_cursor_focus_open selection); each renamed local lands at exactly 1 scope (non_rejected, allowed, submit_candidates, paste_candidates); no other variable group newly reaches the >= 5 threshold.

The suites that exercise the renamed sanitize paths (the command picker unit tests covering cursor submit/paste/focus_open, antigravity and vscodium policy, the autonomous submit strategy, and the daemon drive handlers) pass unchanged - pure rename of function-internal locals plus one inlined selection - and ruff reports zero errors on the touched file.
GOV-PASS 0 errors 0 warnings from the ticket worktree with the changed files declared.
